title: Luconia Network Modpack
description: This is the recommended Modpack to use in the Luconia Network
body:
The official Luconia Network Modpack is our take at an enhanced vanilla experienced on Minecraft: Java Edition. It includes all the mods we officially support on our crossplay Minecraft servers network available via `luconia.net`, while also featuring great mods for singleplayer or other multiplayer experiences.

# ⭐ Key Features
- [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons) to have a greater render distance with LODs with minimal performance impact.
- [SimpleVoicechat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat) to speak with others (You will be muted by default)
- [AppleSkin](https://modrinth.com/mod/appleskin) to also show saturation in the hunger bar.
- [Complimentary Unbound](https://modrinth.com/shader/complementary-unbound) + [Euphoria Patches](https://modrinth.com/mod/euphoria-patches) Shader
  - Together with [Vanilla Mashup (PBR)](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/vanilla-mashup-pbr)
- [Singleplayer World Backups](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloud-save-manager) to easily save and load your local worlds from the cloud.
- Various performance mods, even enhancing block entity rendering, which causes a big performance loss normally and is not fixed in a lot of popular modpacks.
